title: Shortcuts to adiabaticity in five-level systems using counter-diabatic driving and time-rescaling optimization
summary: Shortcuts to adiabaticity (STA) is a common protocol to realize high-fidelity and robust quantum control in various quantum systems. To date, STA has been widely applied in two- and three-level systems, whereas designing feasible strategies to achieve perfect quantum state engineering in multi-level systems still remains a challenging task.
